comments.author: @wekeepwalking4k
comments.text: It’s honestly surprising how many people around the world know so little about Kenya beyond its wildlife and safaris. This country has breathtaking landscapes, incredible cultural diversity, fascinating traditions, and so much history that deserves to be explored. What amazes me is how many travelers overlook places like this while visiting the same popular destinations over and over again. Kenya has so much more to offer than most people realize, yet many will never get to experience its true beauty or understand the lives of the people who call it home. Is it a lack of awareness, or do people simply underestimate destinations they don’t know much about? I think Kenya deserves far more recognition than it gets. 🌍

replies.author: @TraceTheGlobe
replies.text: We completely agree. Kenya is so much more than its famous safaris and wildlife. Its extraordinary landscapes, cultural diversity, rich history, and the everyday lives of its people deserve just as much attention. One of the reasons we created this documentary was to explore those lesser-known dimensions and show a more complete picture of the country. We hope it inspires more people to look beyond the familiar images and discover everything Kenya has to offer. 🌍❤
